app_fee.value: A non-refundable $45 USD charge applies to each new application, paid by credit card when you apply.
app_fee.quote: There is a non-refundable, $45 USD charge for each new application submitted

fee_waiver.value: A fee waiver is offered only in special cases, such as recruitment events or agreements with universities abroad.
fee_waiver.quote: In special circumstances such as graduate program recruitment events, open houses or agreements with universities abroad, an application charge waiver may be offered

gre_general.value: The Graduate School does not set a GRE rule; each program sets its own.
gre_general.quote: Official standard admission test scores (GRE, GMAT, etc.)

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 79 is the minimum for full admission; a MyBest TOEFL score is accepted.

ielts_min.value: IELTS 6.5 is the minimum for full admission.

english_waiver.value: A degree from an institution outside the US where the language of instruction was English is accepted in place of a test score.
english_waiver.quote: Baccalaureate or graduate degree at an institution outside of the U.S. where the language of instruction was English

notes: Some programs may require a higher English level than the Graduate School minimum. Citizens of listed English-speaking countries are exempt from the test; India is not on that list.
